title: 美股科技反弹与本地财报催化托底，期指转弱和A股窄幅分化约束追高
summary: 隔夜美股半导体与光通信反弹，汽车/充电桩、通信设备和存储居前；香农芯创、中兴通讯、多利科技财报提供本地映射，但均缺公告后价格确认，格力业绩下滑构成消费反证。10月26日A股2446涨/2950跌、中位-0.22%，周二期指小幅转弱，开盘需验证宽度和成交。

关键词云图

科技金融产创融合通信设备存储概念汽车制造充电桩半导体A股分化恒科偏弱期指转弱格力反证油价高位
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
油价回落但中东供应风险仍在
周一Brent收低，约07:20 CST WTI报101.42美元、跌0.33%，Brent报110.23美元、微涨0.03%；沙特与胡塞武装相关袭击令供应溢价仍处高位。
美股
科技、半导体与光通信推动美股收高
10月26日道指、标普500和纳指分别上涨0.28%、0.70%和0.83%，半导体指数涨2.8%、科技板块涨1.5%；Lumentum与Coherent约涨8%和6%，但Meta因AI融资计划跌1.9%。
政策
多部门完善科技金融体制
10月26日公开的多部门指导意见提出在北京、上海、粤港澳大湾区等区域强化科技金融服务和直接融资支持，政策利好科技企业融资，但落地节奏与资金成本仍需跟踪。
政策
科技部强调科技创新与产业创新深度融合
科技部10月26日政策问答强调企业牵头科研任务、成果转化和战略性新兴产业培育；对算力、先进制造和产业软件形成中期支撑，但不替代订单与盈利验证。
市场
A股宽度偏弱，港股指数分化
AKShare 10月26日12:48 CST盘中快照显示A股2446涨、2950跌、174平，中位跌0.22%；上证跌0.18%、创业板跌1.65%。港股944涨、1079跌、1123平，恒指涨0.44%而恒科跌0.37%。
美股
汽车、通信设备与存储位居隔夜排行前列
08:28 CST的Moomoo快照显示汽车制造+3.86%、通信设备+3.51%、半导体+2.60%；充电桩+4.46%、新能源汽车+4.04%、存储概念+3.30%。行业Bottom5由受监管自来水、啤酒、地区银行、太阳能与百货构成。
业绩
香农芯创三季报高增，公告后价格待确认
公司披露三季度营收462.21亿元、同比+398.27%，归母净利润16.99亿元、同比+743.02%；前三季度归母净利润53.40亿元、同比+1386.13%。10月26日收于109.06元、跌4.90%，且公告在收盘后，不能视为公告后的价格反馈。
业绩
中兴通讯单季改善，九个月利润与现金流仍承压
中兴通讯三季度营收388.13亿元、同比+33.99%，归母净利润13.07亿元、同比+394.46%；但前三季度归母净利润同比-23.71%、经营现金流同比-59.78%，存货升至736.35亿元。A股10月26日收于28.03元、跌0.46%，公告后价格尚未形成。
业绩
多利科技高增对应汽车制造强势
前三季度营收40.32亿元、同比+48.82%，归母净利润2.63亿元、同比+37.28%；三季度归母净利润9451万元、同比+176.27%，但毛利率同比下降1.42个百分点。10月26日收于15.11元、涨1.48%，仍是公告前价格。
业绩
格力电器三季度利润显著下降
格力电器三季度营收366.78亿元、同比-7.97%，归母净利润39.96亿元、同比-43.31%；前三季度营收和归母净利润分别同比-8.10%和-19.51%。10月26日收于37.18元，公告在收盘后，先列回避观察。
港股
HKEX方向扫描未发现足以改变主线的大型新增事件
对业绩、停复牌、澄清及重大交易进行定向核验，发现的宝石资本停牌与宝新金融私有化/复牌事项规模较小，未纳入核心判断；中兴通讯A/H双重上市事项已在公司业绩中合并处理。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
现金市场上涨后，周二期指小幅转弱
约07:20 CST，道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别-0.13%、-0.11%和-0.02%；报价为约一小时延迟快照，显示追涨动能不足但尚非全面风险反转。
对照
排行代表股多数延续现金时段方向
对14个可核验代表符号的延迟/延长时段末笔查询与排行方向大体一致：CENN、CLRO、EAF、MSGY、TSLA、NOK、GEV、RMBS等仍为正；GCTS.WS未取得可比报价。该查询不是独立的盘后涨跌，故仅作延续性对照。
映射
通信、存储与汽车有本地事件，仍需开盘确认
中兴通讯、香农芯创和多利科技分别对应通信设备、存储和汽车制造强势，但三份公告均在10月26日收盘后，不能用公告前收盘价声称已确认；格力业绩下滑构成消费链反证。

开盘结论

隔夜科技与半导体反弹，通信、存储和汽车有可核验的本地财报映射。 但A股宽度偏弱、创业板和恒科相对落后，周二期指亦小幅转弱。
开盘以条件观察为主，不把公告前价格当作催化后确认。 若宽度改善且至少两只条件关注股守住前收，再提高进攻权重。

重点个股关注

香农芯创
SZ.300475
条件关注
事实与状态：三季度营收与归母净利润同比高增，直接对应隔夜存储概念+3.30%；10月26日收于109.06元、跌4.90%，但公告在收盘后。
确认条件：开盘不再扩大低开、并在前收109.06元附近形成稳定承接，同时存储链宽度不转弱。
风险与失效：若低开后继续放量下跌，或高增无法转化为订单/现金流改善，取消关注；当前不是即时买入确认。
中兴通讯
SZ.000063 / HK.00763
条件关注
事实与状态：三季度收入和利润改善，映射通信设备+3.51%；但前三季度利润与经营现金流仍下滑、存货显著增加。A股10月26日收于28.03元、跌0.46%，为公告前价格。
确认条件：A/H至少一地开盘获得正反馈，且A股守住28.03元前收或港股相对恒科转强。
风险与失效：若双地均弱于指数，或库存与现金流压力继续被定价，维持观察而不升级为看多候选。
多利科技
SZ.001311
条件关注
事实与状态：前三季度收入和利润增长，三季度利润增速较快，映射汽车制造+3.86%与充电桩+4.46%；10月26日15.11元、涨1.48%仍是公告前价格。
确认条件：站稳15.11元前收、成交温和放大且汽车零部件板块不转弱。
风险与失效：毛利率同比下降；若高开低走并跌破前收，或板块强势未传导至A股，取消关注。
格力电器
SZ.000651
回避
事实与状态：三季度营收同比下降7.97%、归母净利润下降43.31%，前三季度利润亦下降19.51%；10月26日收于37.18元，公告后尚无价格反馈。
确认条件：仅在开盘消化利空后重新站稳37.18元，并有明确基本面解释与板块承接时，才从回避降为观察。
风险与失效：利润降幅显著，家电消费链未获隔夜排行正向映射；任何反弹均不能自动包装成多头。

板块轮动看板

相对受益
通信设备、存储与汽车零部件有隔夜强势及本地财报双重线索，但只作条件关注。
等待确认
香农芯创、中兴通讯、多利科技均缺公告后交易，开盘量价与板块宽度是升级前提。
压力方向
家电消费、受监管公用事业、啤酒、地区银行和太阳能；格力财报构成明确本地反证。
验证信号
A股中位涨跌转正、创业板相对上证止跌，且三只条件关注股至少两只守住前收。

逻辑链

隔夜科技、半导体与光通信上涨，美股汽车制造、通信设备、半导体及存储概念居前，提供结构性风险偏好线索。
香农芯创、中兴通讯、多利科技分别把存储、通信和汽车强势映射到A/H公司事件；但公告后价格均未产生，状态只能是条件关注。
10月26日A股2446涨、2950跌且中位跌0.22%，创业板弱于上证；港股恒指上涨而恒科下跌，说明本地广度尚未确认进攻。
周二期指小幅转弱、油价仍高于101美元；因此开盘策略是验证而非追高，格力的利润下滑继续作为消费链风险反证。

风险雷达

三只条件关注股的引用价格均在公告前，任何开盘缺口都可能迅速改写判断。
A股下跌家数多于上涨家数、创业板跌1.65%，科技高弹性方向存在拥挤与补跌风险。
格力三季度利润同比下降43.31%，消费链盈利压力不得被指数反弹掩盖。
WTI仍在101美元上方，中东供应风险可能重新推高通胀与长端利率。

数据来源与时间点

Major News
Global
Oil eases, but Middle East supply risk remains
Brent settled lower Monday; around 07:20 CST WTI was $101.42, down 0.33%, while Brent was $110.23, up 0.03%. Saudi/Houthi-related attacks keep a sizable supply premium in place.
U.S.
Tech, semiconductors and optical networking lift U.S. stocks
On Oct 26, the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 0.28%, 0.70% and 0.83%. The semiconductor index gained 2.8% and tech rose 1.5%; Lumentum and Coherent advanced about 8% and 6%, while Meta fell 1.9% on its AI financing plan.
Policy
Multiple agencies strengthen the technology-finance framework
Multi-agency guidance published Oct 26 calls for stronger technology-finance services and direct-financing support in Beijing, Shanghai and the Greater Bay Area. It is supportive for tech funding, while implementation and funding costs still need monitoring.
Policy
MOST emphasizes deeper integration of technology and industry
A MOST policy Q&A on Oct 26 stresses enterprise-led research, commercialization and strategic emerging industries. This supports computing, advanced manufacturing and industrial software, but does not replace order and earnings verification.
Market
A-share breadth is soft as Hong Kong indices diverge
AKShare's Oct 26 12:48 CST intraday snapshot shows 2,446 A-shares up, 2,950 down and 174 flat, with a -0.22% median; Shanghai fell 0.18% and ChiNext 1.65%. In Hong Kong, 944 rose, 1,079 fell and 1,123 were flat; the Hang Seng gained 0.44% while HSTECH fell 0.37%.
U.S.
Autos, communications equipment and storage lead overnight rankings
Moomoo's 08:28 CST snapshot shows Auto Manufacturers +3.86%, Communication Equipment +3.51% and Semiconductors +2.60%; EV Charging +4.46%, Electric Vehicles +4.04% and Data Storage +3.30%. The industry bottom five are Regulated Water, Brewers, Regional Banks, Solar and Department Stores.
Earnings
Shannon Semi posts strong growth; post-filing price confirmation pending
The company reported Q3 revenue of RMB46.221bn, up 398.27%, and attributable profit of RMB1.699bn, up 743.02%; nine-month attributable profit reached RMB5.340bn, up 1,386.13%. It closed Oct 26 at RMB109.06, down 4.90%, but the filing came after the close, so this is not post-filing price feedback.
Earnings
ZTE improves in Q3, while nine-month profit and cash flow remain pressured
ZTE reported Q3 revenue of RMB38.813bn, up 33.99%, and attributable profit of RMB1.307bn, up 394.46%. Yet nine-month attributable profit fell 23.71%, operating cash flow fell 59.78%, and inventory rose to RMB73.635bn. The A-share closed Oct 26 at RMB28.03, down 0.46%; no post-filing price signal is available yet.
Earnings
Duoli Technology's growth maps to strength in auto manufacturing
Nine-month revenue was RMB4.032bn, up 48.82%, and attributable profit RMB263m, up 37.28%; Q3 attributable profit rose 176.27% to RMB94.51m, while gross margin fell 1.42 percentage points. The stock closed Oct 26 at RMB15.11, up 1.48%, but that was pre-filing.
Earnings
Gree Electric posts a sharp Q3 profit decline
Gree reported Q3 revenue of RMB36.678bn, down 7.97%, and attributable profit of RMB3.996bn, down 43.31%; nine-month revenue and attributable profit fell 8.10% and 19.51%. It closed Oct 26 at RMB37.18 and filed after the close, so it remains an avoid/risk watch.
HKEX
HKEX directional scan finds no large new event that changes the thesis
A directional check of results, suspensions/resumptions, clarifications and major transactions found smaller-cap events involving Baoshi Capital and a privatization/resumption case, neither material enough for the core thesis. ZTE's dual A/H listing is addressed in the company earnings item.

U.S. Overnight Summary

Futures
Futures edge lower after a stronger cash session
Around 07:20 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.13%, 0.11% and 0.02%. The snapshot was delayed by about an hour, indicating limited chase momentum rather than a broad risk reversal.
Cross-check
Most ranking representatives retain their cash-session direction
Delayed/extended-session last prints for 14 verifiable representative symbols broadly match the ranking direction: CENN, CLRO, EAF, MSGY, TSLA, NOK, GEV and RMBS remained positive; a comparable GCTS.WS quote was unavailable. These are not independent after-hours returns and are used only as continuity checks.
A/H map
Communications, storage and autos have local catalysts but need opening confirmation
ZTE, Shannon Semi and Duoli Technology map to strength in communications equipment, storage and auto manufacturing, but all three filings came after the Oct 26 close, so pre-filing closes cannot be treated as confirmation. Gree's earnings decline is a consumer-sector counter-signal.

Opening View

Overnight tech and semiconductor gains have verifiable local earnings read-throughs in communications, storage and autos. But A-share breadth is soft, ChiNext and HSTECH lag, and Tuesday futures edged lower.
Treat the open as conditional observation; do not use pre-filing prices as post-catalyst confirmation. Raise offensive exposure only if breadth improves and at least two conditional watches hold their prior closes.

Stocks to Watch

香农芯创
SZ.300475
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: Q3 revenue and attributable profit rose sharply year over year, directly mapping to the overnight Data Storage group (+3.30%). It closed Oct 26 at RMB109.06, down 4.90%, but the filing came after the close.
Confirmation: No further gap-down at the open, stable support near the RMB109.06 prior close, and no deterioration in storage-sector breadth.
Risk & invalidation: If it extends lower on volume, or growth fails to translate into orders and cash flow, drop the watch. This is not an immediate buy confirmation.
中兴通讯
SZ.000063 / HK.00763
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: Q3 revenue and profit improved, mapping to Communication Equipment (+3.51%), but nine-month profit and operating cash flow declined and inventory rose materially. The A-share closed Oct 26 at RMB28.03, down 0.46%, before the filing.
Confirmation: Positive opening feedback in at least one listing, with the A-share holding RMB28.03 or the H-share outperforming HSTECH.
Risk & invalidation: If both listings lag their benchmarks, or inventory and cash-flow pressure is repriced, keep it as observation rather than upgrading to bullish.
多利科技
SZ.001311
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: Nine-month revenue and profit grew and Q3 profit accelerated, mapping to Auto Manufacturers (+3.86%) and EV Charging (+4.46%). The Oct 26 close of RMB15.11, up 1.48%, was still pre-filing.
Confirmation: Hold above the RMB15.11 prior close with moderate volume expansion and no reversal in auto-parts breadth.
Risk & invalidation: Gross margin declined year over year. Cancel the watch if it gaps up and fades below the prior close or if U.S. group strength does not carry into A-shares.
格力电器
SZ.000651
Avoid
Facts & status: Q3 revenue fell 7.97% and attributable profit 43.31%; nine-month profit also fell 19.51%. The stock closed Oct 26 at RMB37.18, with no post-filing price feedback yet.
Confirmation: Only move from avoid to watch if the stock absorbs the news, regains RMB37.18, and receives clear fundamental explanation plus sector support.
Risk & invalidation: The profit decline is material and home appliances lack a positive overnight ranking read-through; any rebound must not be automatically framed as bullish.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative beneficiaries
Communications equipment, storage and auto parts have both overnight strength and local earnings catalysts, but remain conditional watches.
Awaiting confirmation
Shannon Semi, ZTE and Duoli lack post-filing trading; opening price-volume and sector breadth are prerequisites for any upgrade.
Pressure areas
Home appliances, regulated utilities, brewers, regional banks and solar; Gree's earnings are a clear local counter-signal.
Validation signals
A-share median breadth turns positive, ChiNext stabilizes versus Shanghai, and at least two of the three conditional watches hold their prior closes.

Logic Chain

Overnight gains in tech, semiconductors and optical networking, plus leadership in autos, communications equipment, semiconductors and storage, provide a structural risk-appetite signal.
Shannon Semi, ZTE and Duoli map storage, communications and auto strength into A/H company events; because none has traded after the filing, each remains only a conditional watch.
On Oct 26, 2,446 A-shares rose and 2,950 fell, with a -0.22% median and ChiNext lagging Shanghai; Hong Kong's HSI rose while HSTECH fell, so local breadth has not confirmed an offensive stance.
U.S. futures edged lower Tuesday and WTI stayed above $101; the opening plan is therefore verification, not chasing, while Gree's profit decline remains a consumer-sector counter-signal.

Risk Radar

All three conditional-watch prices are pre-filing; any opening gap can quickly change the assessment.
A-share decliners outnumbered advancers and ChiNext fell 1.65%, leaving crowded high-beta tech exposed to catch-down risk.
Gree's Q3 profit fell 43.31% year over year; consumer earnings pressure must not be obscured by an index rebound.
WTI remains above $101, and Middle East supply risk could re-accelerate inflation and long-end yields.
